_comment: Lua Language Server configuration for CONTRIBUTORS working on cis_libs itself.
A CONSUMER does not use this file -- a consumer adds types/ to their own
.luarc.json workspace.library. The difference matters: this file also lints
the resource's own server files, and the platform globals it declares are
types/ IS THE WORKSPACE LIBRARY, and it is listed twice on purpose:
* workspace.library is what LuaLS offers as a completion source, and
* the path itself is what makes the annotations resolve when a file in
this resource references a declared class.
One is enough for a consumer; both are needed here, and the second entry is
what stopped a class defined in types/ from reading as an undefined global
